name: Fajardo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue — the red for the border of the shield, the white for its main charges and the blue for the sky and sea of Fajardo — charged at the centre with the arms of the villa in natural colours.
history: Fajardo is a town and a municipality part of the San Juan-Caguas-Fajardo Combined Statistical Area in Puerto Rico.

features.role: arms of the villa, a shield with a sailboat supported by two sea-dragons
